[EN] Bring 'Em Back Alive
[ES] Traerlos de vuelta con vida
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] We can't let the argons hold our people.
[ES] No podemos dejar que los argones retengan a nuestra gente.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Words of gratitude seem inadequate to the miracle you wrought.
[ES] Las palabras de gratitud parecen insuficientes para el milagro que has obrado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Meet {@LinkCreature:246#3002#Arnan} at {@Rgn:46015$$Hexheart Chamber} in the {@Rgn:46002$$Raga Evala}.
[ES] Reúnete con {@LinkCreature:246#3002#Arnan} en la {@Rgn:46015$$Hexheart Chamber} dentro de {@Rgn:46002$$Raga Evala}.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "As ordered."
[ES] "Como ordenes."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Teleport Scroll
[ES] Pergamino de teletransporte
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Operate the transmogrification pod controls west of the camp to rescue the prisoner, and then use the teleport scroll.
[ES] Acciona los controles de la cápsula de transfiguración al oeste del campamento para rescatar al prisionero y luego usa el pergamino de teletransporte.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "This will get you to safety."
[ES] "Esto te llevará a un lugar seguro."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
